title: Stay near the Perfect Guru, not another portion
summary: The Creator is already near, and the True Guru is perfect. Envy loosens when the heart returns to the duty and grace actually given.
takeaway: Return envy to the duty given under the Perfect Guru.
lifeApplication: When another life starts looking larger than yours, name one work of remembrance or service already in your hands and complete it without comparison.

source.shortMeaning: The Creator is near, and the True Guru is perfect; the heart does not need to steal its measure from another life.
source.lifeApplication: Before naming someone else's advantage, return to the work, prayer, or duty already entrusted to you.

evidence.coreClaim: The Creator is near, and the True Guru is perfect; comparison forgets the nearness already given.
evidence.turn: Envy loosens when the heart stands before the Perfect Guru instead of another person's portion.
evidence.practicalImplication: When another life starts looking larger than yours, name one work of remembrance or service already in your hands and complete it without comparison.
